accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Account name to resolve to AccountId. Use when creating opportunities or filtering by account. Fuzzy matching supported - "Memorial" will match "Memorial Regional Hospital".

addLineItemsJson.title: Add Line Items JSON
addLineItemsJson.description: JSON array of NEW line items to add to an existing opportunity. Format: [{"Product2Id":"01tXXX...","Quantity":10,"UnitPrice":450.00}]. For product names, use productName parameter or include in JSON. Example with product name: [{"productName":"Cardiomax 100mg","Quantity":50,"UnitPrice":650}].

aggregateField.title: Aggregate Field
aggregateField.description: For aggregate operation: Field to aggregate. Use "Amount" for pipeline totals, "Id" for counts. Example: "Amount" for SUM pipeline, "Id" for COUNT deals.

aggregateFunction.title: Aggregate Function
aggregateFunction.description: For aggregate operation: SUM (total pipeline), COUNT (how many deals), AVG (average deal size), MIN, MAX. Example: "SUM" for "what is my total pipeline", "COUNT" for "how many deals in negotiation".

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: For create/update: Set to false to preview only. For delete: Set to true to actually delete.

dateRangeDays.title: Date Range Days
dateRangeDays.description: For aggregate operation with LAST_N_DAYS or NEXT_N_DAYS: Number of days. Example: 30 for "last 30 days".

dateRangeEnd.title: Date Range End
dateRangeEnd.description: For aggregate operation with SPECIFIC MONTH: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use INSTEAD OF dateRangePredefined for specific months. Example: "2026-03-31" for "opportunities closing in March". Must be used with dateRangeStart.

dateRangeField.title: Date Range Field
dateRangeField.description: For aggregate operation: Date field to filter on. Use "CloseDate" for opportunity close dates. Example: "CloseDate" for "deals closing this month".

dateRangePredefined.title: Date Range Predefined
dateRangePredefined.description: For aggregate operation: Predefined date range - TODAY, THIS_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, THIS_QUARTER, THIS_YEAR, LAST_MONTH, LAST_QUARTER, LAST_N_DAYS, NEXT_N_DAYS. Example: "THIS_MONTH" for "closing this month", "THIS_QUARTER" for "this quarter".

dateRangeStart.title: Date Range Start
dateRangeStart.description: For aggregate operation with SPECIFIC MONTH: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use INSTEAD OF dateRangePredefined for specific months. Example: "2026-03-01" for "opportunities closing in March". Must be used with dateRangeEnd.

deleteLineItemIds.title: Delete Line Item IDs
deleteLineItemIds.description: JSON array of line item IDs to remove from the opportunity. Format: ["00kXXX...","00kYYY..."]. Use for removing products from a deal.

fieldDataJson.title: Field Data JSON
fieldDataJson.description: JSON string containing Opportunity field data. PIPELINE MANAGEMENT FOCUS: This action helps sales reps quickly update their deals. STAGE UPDATES: When user says "move to proposal" or "advance the deal" or "we are in negotiation now", map to StageName. Valid stages typically: Prospecting, Qualification, Needs Analysis, Value Proposition, Id. Decision Makers, Perception Analysis, Proposal/Price Quote, Negotiation/Review, Closed Won, Closed Lost. AMOUNT UPDATES: When user mentions dollar amounts like "$150K" or "deal is now worth 200 thousand", update Amount field. CLOSE DATE: When user says "pushing to next quarter" or "closing end of month" or "slipping to March", update CloseDate. NEXT STEPS: Capture action items in NextStep field - "send proposal", "schedule demo", "get legal review". FORECAST: ForecastCategoryName values: Pipeline, Best Case, Commit, Omitted, Closed. For create: {"Name":"Memorial Hospital - Cardiology Expansion","StageName":"Qualification","CloseDate":"2026-03-31","Amount":150000}. For update: {"StageName":"Proposal/Price Quote","Amount":175000,"NextStep":"Send final proposal by Friday"}. IMPORTANT: For picklist fields, query availableFieldsJson from a previous read operation to see valid values.

filtersJson.title: Filters JSON
filtersJson.description: JSON filters for find operations. PIPELINE USE CASES: {"StageName":"Proposal/Price Quote"} finds deals in proposal stage. {"ForecastCategoryName":"Commit"} finds committed deals. {"IsClosed":false} finds open deals only. Combine with searchTerm for refined results like "show me Memorial Hospital deals in negotiation".

groupByFieldsJson.title: Group By Fields JSON
groupByFieldsJson.description: For aggregate operation: JSON array of fields to group by. Example: ["StageName"] for pipeline by stage, ["StageName","OwnerId"] for pipeline by stage and owner.

lineItemsJson.title: Line Items JSON
lineItemsJson.description: JSON array of line items to create WITH a new opportunity. Format: [{"Product2Id":"01tXXX...","Quantity":10,"UnitPrice":450.00},{"PricebookEntryId":"01uXXX...","Quantity":5}]. Can use Product2Id or PricebookEntryId. If using Product2Id, system will find the Standard Pricebook entry.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: REQUIRED for summaries: "aggregate" for ANY question about totals, counts, averages, sums, or grouped data. "find" ONLY for listing individual deals. Other: "create", "read", "update", "delete". AGGREGATE TRIGGERS: total, sum, how many, count, average, biggest, smallest, by stage, pipeline breakdown. EXAMPLE: "whats my total pipeline" -> operation="aggregate" NOT "find".

recordId.title: Record ID
recordId.description: The Opportunity ID. Required for read/update/delete operations. When updating line items, this must be the OPPORTUNITY ID (starts with 006), NOT the line item ID. Line item IDs go in updateLineItemsJson.

searchLimit.title: Search Limit
searchLimit.description: Maximum records to return for find operations (default: 5, max: 20). For pipeline reviews, consider higher limits.

searchTerm.title: Search Term
searchTerm.description: Text to search for Opportunities. Searches: Opportunity Name, Account Name, Description. Flexible matching - partial names work. Examples: "Memorial Hospital" finds opps for that account, "Cardiology" finds opps with that in the name, "oncology treatment" finds related deals. For pipeline reviews, combine with filtersJson for stage filtering.

updateLineItemsJson.title: Update Line Items JSON
updateLineItemsJson.description: JSON array of line items to update. Put OPPORTUNITY ID in recordId, LINE ITEM IDs here. Format: [{"Id":"00kXXX...","Quantity":150},{"Id":"00kYYY...","UnitPrice":500}]. Get line item IDs from a previous read operation.
